text: The Supplier's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed two (2) times the Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, save that no limit shall apply to liability for fraud, wilful misconduct or breach of confidentiality.

The Supplier's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, save that no limit shall apply to liability for fraud, wilful misconduct or breach of confidentiality.

The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless Veridian against all losses arising from (a) any claim that the Services or Deliverables infringe the intellectual property rights of a third party, and (b) any personal data breach caused by the Supplier or its personnel.
The Supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless Veridian against all losses arising from any claim that the Services or Deliverables infringe the intellectual property rights of a third party.
The obligations in this clause shall survive for five (5) years after the expiry or termination of this Agreement.
The obligations in this clause shall survive for three (3) years after the expiry or termination of this Agreement.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with it.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration seated in Mumbai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, by a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement.
Veridian may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving the Supplier not less than thirty (30) days' written notice.
Veridian may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving the Supplier not less than sixty (60) days' written notice.
Veridian shall pay each undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days of receiving a valid GST-compliant invoice.
Veridian shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receiving a valid GST-compliant invoice.

The Supplier shall process personal data only on Veridian's documented instructions and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and shall notify Veridian of any personal data breach without undue delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.
The Supplier shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and shall notify Veridian of any personal data breach within seven (7) days of becoming aware of it.
All Deliverables and all intellectual property rights in them shall vest in Veridian on creation. The Supplier hereby assigns all such rights to Veridian.

The Supplier retains ownership of the intellectual property in the Deliverables and grants Veridian a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, worldwide licence to use, modify and copy them for its business.
Veridian or its auditors may, on fifteen (15) days' written notice, audit the Supplier's records, systems and premises relevant to the Services.
Veridian or its auditors may, on thirty (30) days' written notice, audit the Supplier's records relevant to the Services, not more than once a year.
The Supplier shall not subcontract any part of the Services without Veridian's prior written consent.
The Supplier may subcontract parts of the Services by giving Veridian at least fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, and remains responsible for its subcontractors.
The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance with a limit of not less than ₹5,00,00,000 (five crore rupees) per claim for the term of this Agreement and two years after.
The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance with a limit of not less than ₹2,00,00,000 (two crore rupees) per claim for the term of this Agreement.
